scenes.text: In 1974, a train left with forty-one passengers.
scenes.art_prompt: a vintage steam train departing an empty rural platform at dawn, sepia tone, archival feel

scenes.text: It arrived empty. Every seat, still warm.
scenes.art_prompt: the interior of an old train carriage, empty seats, weak morning light, eerie stillness

scenes.text: One witness filed a report the next day.
scenes.art_prompt: a typewritten police report on a cluttered desk, single lamp, 1970s office, sepia

scenes.text: He described a man who never boarded. Who simply was already inside.
scenes.art_prompt: a shadowy figure reflected in a train window, not present on the platform outside

scenes.text:
When investigators followed up, they found no record of the witness either.
Only his signature, dated 1974.
scenes.art_prompt: an old case file open to a blank identification page, one handwritten signature, dim archive room

scenes.text: Follow Unsolved Archive for more cases.
scenes.art_prompt: rows of old archive boxes receding into shadow, single overhead light, final and unresolved
